about:
First Electronics Inc. (FEI) is a contract electronics manufacturer headquartered in Chandler, Arizona. The company provides full-service assembly of printed circuit boards, cable and wire harnesses, and electromechanical box builds, along with testing and engineering support.

FEI’s capabilities span surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, conformal coating, X-ray inspection, and pre- and post-reflow automated optical inspection. The shop handles projects from engineering prototypes to large-volume production runs, with a dynamic component library that tracks up to 99 alternate images per part. Customized test equipment is used for in-circuit and functional testing of finished assemblies, and the company provides engineering support throughout the product lifecycle.

The company serves customers in wind energy technology, healthcare and medical devices, and telecommunications. Typical programs include control boards for wind turbines, medical diagnostic equipment, and telecom infrastructure hardware, all built to ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 quality standards.

FEI emphasizes quality from the quoting stage, citing customer satisfaction as its primary goal, and differentiates itself through advanced inspection technology and customized test solutions tailored to each program. The company also offers complete X-ray services and a global component library to reduce sourcing risk.
